title: jmap-base-client: generic SetCall (conditional + restore), ConditionalError
description:
Design: docs/design/conditional.md. Decisions: docs/design/DECISIONS.md.
Note key: C6. Crates: jmap-base-client. Size: M.

Implement docs/design/conditional.md §8 (conditional-02 §2.1, §3, §3.3, §4.2, §4.3; object-history-03 §5.1). Decision 8 (docs/design/DECISIONS.md), non-breaking: Session::supports_conditional(); #[non_exhaustive] SetCall {account_id, if_in_state, create, update, destroy, conditional: ConditionalSetArgs, restore: BTreeMap<Id, Option<PatchObject>> (omitted when empty), extra}; JmapClient::set_call::<R>(session, method, extra_using, &call): using = core + extra_using + conditional URI only when conditional is non-default; object-history URI is the caller's (no dep on object-history-types). ConditionalError::from_method_error(&JmapError) -> Option<ConditionalError> {StateMismatch{failed}, AtomicFailure(AtomicFailure), CannotApplyAtomically}, matching Other(s) against the C1 consts (decision 7); rustdoc notes older clients see cannotApplyAtomically as serverFail (§4.3). Can run in parallel with C2-C5. Acceptance: §10 base-client tests (SetCall vs example 5.9 request JSON; SetCall with restore and default conditional has no conditional URI; ConditionalError from 5.1 error JSON and from atomicFailure/cannotApplyAtomically JSON; using contains the URI only when args set); wiremock round trip; public-api additions only.
